item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Projects the hour before aggregation, preserving NULL groups and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) AS projected GROUP BY hour"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Uses window counts and DISTINCT to return one row per hour, preserving duplicates in the counts and the NULL partition.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Uses conditional aggregation and removes groups without qualifying rows, preserving the original day predicate and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filters before window counting and deduplicates route results, preserving NULL route keys, duplicate counts, and anomalous dates.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"}]}
